flows.name: place_order
flows.description: Open a product, tap Buy now, fill the delivery form and place an order.
steps: open a product from the shop list
wait for the detail screen to load
fill Full name, Email, Phone, Address, City and Pincode
state_at_risk: the six typed delivery form fields
the order confirmation and order id

risks.why: submit throws IOException when offline and placeOrder launches it in viewModelScope with no try/catch, so the app crashes.
with airplane mode on there is no active network, submit throws the uncaught IOException raised at the call site in the ViewModel coroutine.
the form fields live in plain mutableStateOf inside the ViewModel with no SavedStateHandle, so after process death the checkout route is restored with an empty form.
risks.trigger: after filling all six checkout fields, before tapping Place order

risks.why: the system destroys the activity without a configuration change, which clears the ViewModelStore and drops the typed form and any order result.
risks.trigger: after filling the checkout form, switch to another app and come back

risks.why: memory pressure on a backgrounded app kills the process and the unsaved ViewModel form with it.
risks.trigger: after filling the checkout form, with the app in the background

risks.why: the ViewModel should keep the form and orderId, but the in-flight placing state and confirmation screen (which reads vm.city) are worth verifying across recreation.
risks.trigger: while the Place order spinner is showing, and again on the Order placed screen

flows.name: detail_deal_popup
flows.description: Open a product and wait for its detail and the Deal unlocked popup to appear.
steps: open a product from the shop list
wait on the loading spinner for the detail to load
state_at_risk: the deal dialog (may be shown twice or over the wrong screen)

risks.why: DealLoader runs in GlobalScope holding the old Activity, and after the 5 s load it calls DialogFragment.show on a FragmentManager whose state is already saved or destroyed, which throws IllegalStateException and crashes the app.
risks.trigger: rotate the device within 5 seconds of opening a product, while the spinner is showing

risks.why: the activity is destroyed while the GlobalScope load is pending, so the later fragment transaction on its FragmentManager throws and crashes.
risks.trigger: open a product, leave the app and return within 5 seconds while the spinner is showing

risks.why: the loaded product is held in remember rather than saved, so after restore the 5 s load and the deal dialog start over.
risks.trigger: after the product detail has loaded

risks.why: the detail Column does not scroll and has a 96sp emoji, so at large font scale the Buy now button can be pushed off screen.
risks.trigger: open a product with the largest font scale and look for the Buy now button

risks.why: the unscoped load is not tied to the lifecycle, so background memory pressure and return can reload the product and show the dialog again.
risks.trigger: open a product and send the app to the background while the spinner is showing

flows.name: scan_coupon
flows.description: On checkout, grant camera permission and scan a coupon, then scan again later.
steps: open a product and tap Buy now
ui_hints: Scanner ready: point the camera at your coupon
Camera permission is needed to scan coupons
state_at_risk: typed checkout form fields if the process is killed by the permission change

risks.why: the grant is cached in SharedPreferences and never rechecked with checkSelfPermission, so after revocation openCamera throws SecurityException.
risks.trigger: tap Scan coupon after the camera permission was granted once and then revoked

risks.why: the stale camera_granted flag written on first grant is what routes the tap to open() instead of asking again.
risks.trigger: tap Scan coupon again after revoking camera in Settings

risks.why: the coupon status text is remembered, not saved, so it resets when the activity is recreated.
risks.trigger: after the scanner ready message appears

flows.name: browse_shop
flows.description: Browse the product list and open and return from product pages.
steps: open the app and see the product list
press back to return to the list
state_at_risk: the loaded product list (reloaded in 800 ms)

risks.why: prices are formatted with the default locale and the row layout has a fixed price Text, so RTL and non-Latin digits could break the row layout.
risks.trigger: scroll the product list after switching to an RTL locale

risks.why: the product list is held in remember and reloaded after restore, so the list shows a spinner and scroll position can be lost.
risks.trigger: while scrolled down in the product list
